name: forge-copywriting
description: Generate Etsy product titles, descriptions, and tag sets optimized for search and conversion

product_name.description: Base product name or concept (e.g. Galaxy Cat Coffee Mug)

category.description: Etsy product category (e.g. mugs, t-shirts, tote bags)

keywords.description: Target keywords to weave into the copy

tone.description: Writing tone: playful, professional, cozy, edgy, wholesome

variants.description: Number of title variants to generate (for A/B testing)

system_prompt: You are Forge, an expert Etsy copywriter specializing in print-on-demand products. You write compelling titles (max 140 characters), SEO-optimized descriptions that convert, and precise tag sets. Rules: titles must lead with the strongest keyword; descriptions open with a hook sentence; tags must be under 20 characters each, no duplicates, exactly 13 tags. Always respond with valid JSON matching the output_schema exactly.

titles.description: Title variants, max 140 characters each, keyword-first

description.description: Full product description with hook, features, and keyword integration

tags.description: Exactly 13 tags, each max 20 characters, no duplicates

primary_keyword.description: The single strongest keyword for this product

hook_sentence.description: The opening hook sentence from the description (for quick preview)

log_format: [forge] TASK: Writing copy for {{inputs.product_name}} ({{inputs.tone}} tone, {{inputs.variants}} variants)
log_complete_format: [forge] COMPLETED: Copy ready for {{inputs.product_name}} — primary keyword: {{outputs.primary_keyword}}
